mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_position_latest (user_id, pos, accuracy_m, heading, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), #{accuracy}, #{heading}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pos = POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), accuracy_m = #{accuracy}, heading = #{heading}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
INSERT INTO user_position_log (user_id, pos, accuracy_m, heading, logged_at) VALUES (#{userId}, POINT(#{lng}, #{lat}), #{accuracy}, #{heading}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, ST_Y(pos) AS lat, ST_X(pos) AS lng, heading, updated_at FROM user_position_latest
SELECT l.user_id, ST_Y(l.pos) AS lat, ST_X(l.pos) AS lng, l.heading, l.updated_at FROM user_position_latest l JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id WHERE u.site_id = #{siteId}
